tasks.ask: Query sf_ops.incidents for station_id 'F10' between Jul 1 and Oct 31 2026, returning kind, cause, ts, shift_code, downtime_min, cars_lost, false_alarm, and description ordered by ts to identify recurring stop patterns.
Query sf_ops.andon_events for station_id 'F10' over the same period, returning reason, response_s, stopped_line, incident_id, and ts ordered by ts to see which andon pulls line-stopped F10.

Join sf_plant.machines at station_id 'F10' to sf_plant.machine_telemetry listing failure, overstrain_failure, heat_dissipation_failure, tool_wear_min, rpm, and torque_nm by hour around F10 stop timestamps to detect machine-level faults.
Retrieve agent traces, model calls, human approvals, and learned lessons from prior F10 investigation steps to summarize what has been checked and which root-cause hypotheses remain open.
